title: The resolvent equations for the Harmonic and bi-Harmonic functional calculi in dimension five
summary: The fine structures on the $S$-spectrum constitute a new research area that includes a class of functional calculi based on the $S$-spectrum and on integral transforms determined by the Fueter--Sce mapping theorem and the Cauchy formula for slice hyperholomorphic functions. This strategy, based on integral transforms, allows us to construct functional calculi that include harmonic and polyharmonic functional calculi.
